==Mythos Source==
Fire vampires first appeared in ''The Fire Vampires'' (1933), written by Donald Wandrei, where they were  lightning-like servants of Fthaggua. The more commonly known version where they are servitors of [[Cthugha]] first appeared in ''The Dweller in Darkness'' (1944), written by August Derleth.
